company.name: First Mills
company.shortDescription: First Mills specializes in milling and producing various flour products, focusing on customer convenience.
company.description: First Mills specializes in milling and manufacturing a range of flour products, including wheat derivatives, bran, and animal feed. The company combines traditional milling practices with modern processing techniques to deliver a consistent portfolio of grain-based goods. It operates with a focus on efficiency, food safety, and product variety to meet the demands of industrial, commercial, and consumer markets.
